[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] '''Jhanil''' was a male [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] soldier who fought to defend his homeworld during the [[Invasion of Manaan]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Captain Jhanil only appears in the Imperial storyline, in which he and his men take [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Seeral Korrd|Korrd]] and his subordinates captive. He is killed by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Anri]] and the Imperial player.
